messages:
maya: Merge blocked: SAST suppression approval failing with AccessDenied when trying to sign off on false-positive for generated client code.

ryan: Screenshot? What error?

maya: UI shows: 
`403 Forbidden: user lacks role sast.suppressionApprover on project redwood-scans`

sophie: We rotated some org roles yesterday (PR infra-5622) to tighten approver list. Maybe suppression approver role was removed unintentionally.

infra-bot: IAM change detected: removed member group:devs@sessions.redwood.com from role sast.suppressionApprover at 2026-06-12T08:12Z by infra-ci (commit d4e2b1).

sec-bot: Audit hint: suppression approvals are audited via scans-audit topic. No approval event found for attempt id sup-8812.

sec-oncall: Short-term fix: issue an ephemeral approver grant for maya so the PR can merge after manual review. I'll grant 20 minutes and capture audit evidence.

ryan: While that unblocks, we should add a premerge check that verifies suppression approver membership for the authoring team and a failing policy if missing. Also require the suppression rationale to include a trace id linking to the scan artifact.

maya: Grant in place, I completed the approval and PR merged. Uploading the suppression justification to SEC-SUPP-4001.

sophie: Follow-ups: (1) infra PR to restore group binding with narrow scope, (2) add CI gate that runs `sastctl verifier check-approver --team devs` as part of pre-merge, (3) alert rule when suppression approver role is removed without a linked ticket in commit message.

sec-bot: Created ticket SEC-SUPP-4001: "sast suppression approver RBAC regression" assigned to sophie, severity P1. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/SEC-SUPP-4001

sec-oncall: Closing incident after audit slice attached and infra PR queued. If anyone sees similar failures, ping me and include the sup id.

ryan: Good catch. Documenting in secure-sdlc: suppression approvals require both audit trace and reviewer identity in the sign-off.
